recommendation.model: Hybrid continuous/granular direction; research hypothesis, not native reimplementation
recommendation.nextExperiment: One exhaust-only coherent-context ablation using the same five eligible consecutive intervals at relative state 21. A uses existing per-marker joins; B retains a continuous cursor internally, applying the unchanged join only at the block wrap. Identical source intervals/order, read-rate mapping, clock, gain, duration and input in both. Prepared only after separate authorisation; not implemented here.
recommendation.limits: About 0.238 seconds of eligible context is not an indefinite steady-state recording. The ablation can reject internal join handling as the main defect without rejecting all hybrid methods. No larger source window or relaxed state/rate bound is presumed.

validation.harmonicPowerNormalisation: All positive-frequency energy via Parseval, not selected low orders only
